summary: Expose producer/consumer stages, arrival counts and buffer reuse in asynchronous data-movement pipelines.
outcomes: Build a correct double-buffered copy/compute schedule.
Explain when asynchronous copy or TMA is supported and beneficial.
sequence: Split load and compute into overlapping stages.
Track shared-buffer ownership and completion phases.
Introduce supported async-copy/TMA descriptors and barriers.
Measure overlap and expose failures from premature reuse.

visual.question: Is this tile ready to read and safe to overwrite?
visual.interaction: Step producer/consumer phases and deliberately omit a completion dependency.

practice.task: Pipeline a tiled kernel with sanitizer and reference checks.
practice.success: All buffer phases are valid; speedup is measured against the same synchronous algorithm.
